tasks.title: Setup Git Ignore File
tasks.prompt: Create the `.gitignore` file. Add standard Node.js, Next.js (`.next/`, `out/`), OS-specific patterns, IDE folders, and log files. Crucially, ensure `.env.local`, `.env.production`, and `node_modules/` are ignored to prevent committing secrets and dependencies.

tasks.title: Configure ESLint Rules
tasks.prompt: Create or modify `.eslintrc.json`. Extend `eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals`. Add necessary plugins for TypeScript (`@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin`) and React (`eslint-plugin-react`, `eslint-plugin-react-hooks`). Configure project-specific rules for code quality and consistency.

tasks.title: Configure ESLint Ignore Patterns
tasks.prompt: Create the `.eslintignore` file. Add patterns for files and directories that ESLint should skip, such as build output (`.next/`, `out/`), `node_modules/`, configuration files (`next.config.mjs`, `postcss.config.js`), and potentially generated type definition files.

tasks.title: Configure Prettier Formatting Rules
tasks.prompt: Create the `.prettierrc.json` file. Define code formatting rules: `semi: true`, `singleQuote: false`, `tabWidth: 2`, `printWidth: 80`, `trailingComma: 'es5'`. Ensure consistency with project standards.

tasks.title: Configure Prettier Ignore Patterns
tasks.prompt: Create the `.prettierignore` file. Add patterns for files and directories Prettier should skip, including build outputs, `package-lock.json`, `yarn.lock`, and potentially large data or configuration files like `*.json` in `config/`.

tasks.title: Configure Tailwind CSS Settings
tasks.prompt: Modify `tailwind.config.ts`. Ensure the `content` array includes paths to all relevant files: `./app/**/*.{ts,tsx}`, `./components/**/*.{ts,tsx}`. Configure theme extensions (colors, fonts) and plugins according to project design. Integrate Shadcn/ui theme settings.

tasks.title: Configure PostCSS Settings
tasks.prompt: Create or modify `postcss.config.js`. Ensure it correctly includes the `tailwindcss` and `autoprefixer` plugins required for processing Tailwind CSS within the Next.js build process.

tasks.title: Setup Global CSS Styles
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/globals.css`. Include the essential Tailwind directives: `@tailwind base;`, `@tailwind components;`, `@tailwind utilities;`. Add any necessary base global styles or CSS variable definitions required by Shadcn/ui or project design.

tasks.title: Initialize/Verify Shadcn/ui Configuration
tasks.prompt: Run `npx shadcn-ui@latest init` if not done, or verify existing `components.json`. Ensure settings for `style`, `tailwind.config`, `tailwind.css`, `tailwind.baseColor`, `tailwind.cssVariables`, `aliases.components`, and `aliases.utils` align with the project structure (`components/ui`, `lib/utils`).

tasks.title: Verify Shadcn/ui Utility Function
tasks.prompt: Verify `lib/utils.ts` contains the `cn` utility function generated by Shadcn/ui for merging Tailwind classes using `clsx` and `tailwind-merge`. Add any other general-purpose utility functions needed early on.

tasks.title: Create Environment Variable Example File
tasks.prompt: Create `.env.example`. List all required environment variables (e.g., `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, potentially `NEXT_PUBLIC_...` variables if needed) with descriptive comments and placeholder values like `YOUR_API_KEY_HERE`.

tasks.title: Initialize Project README
tasks.prompt: Create the initial `README.md`. Include the project title 'Skaldur', a brief overview explaining its purpose (prompt refinement workbench), and initial sections for 'Getting Started' (cloning, dependencies) and 'Running Locally'.

tasks.title: Create Developer Setup Guide
tasks.prompt: Create `docs/SETUP_GUIDE.md`. Provide detailed, step-by-step instructions for developers: prerequisites (Node.js version), cloning the repository, installing dependencies (`npm install` or `yarn`), setting up `.env.local` with API keys, and running the development server (`npm run dev`).

tasks.title: Initialize Architecture Document
tasks.prompt: Create `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. Outline the main sections based on the blueprint: Project Overview, System Architecture, Technology Stack, Data Models, API Design, UI, Security, Performance, Testing, Deployment, Future Considerations. Add brief placeholders.

tasks.title: Initialize API Guide Document
tasks.prompt: Create `docs/API_GUIDE.md`. Outline sections for each planned API endpoint: `/api/config/improvement-options`, `/api/improve`, `/api/name-session`. Include placeholders for Method, URL, Description, Request Body Schema, Success Response, Error Responses.

tasks.title: Setup Basic CI Workflow (GitHub Actions)
tasks.prompt: Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Configure a basic GitHub Actions workflow triggered on `push` and `pull_request` to `main`. Include jobs to checkout code, setup Node.js (specify version), install dependencies (`npm ci`), and run linters (`npm run lint`).

tasks.title: Create TypeScript Types Index File
tasks.prompt: Create `types/index.ts`. This file will serve as the central export point for types defined in other files within the `types` directory. Start with an empty file or a comment indicating its purpose.

tasks.title: Define Utility TypeScript Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/utility.ts`. Define and export any common, reusable utility types needed across the application, such as generic types for optional properties or specific data transformations.

tasks.title: Define Session TypeScript Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/session.ts`. Define and export interfaces: `Message` (id, role, content, timestamp), `InteractionLLMSettings` (provider, model, temperature, maxTokens), `DestinationLLMSettings` (provider, model), `LockedSettings` (containing both LLM settings), `SessionDetails` (uuid, messages, lockedSettings), `SessionMetadata` (uuid, name, createdAt, lastModified).

tasks.title: Define Configuration TypeScript Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/config.ts`. Define and export interfaces: `ImprovementTypePublic` (id, name, icon, description), `ImprovementType` (extends public, adds systemPrompt, template), `LLMOption` (id, name), `LLMOptionGroup` (provider, models array), `ImprovementOptionsResponse` (types, styles, interactionLlmOptions, destinationLlmOptions).

tasks.title: Define API TypeScript Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/api.ts`. Define and export interfaces for API request/response payloads: `ImprovePromptRequest` (sessionUUID, userInput, etc., including optional LLM settings), `ImprovePromptResponse` (improvedPrompt, sessionUUID), `NameSessionRequest` (sessionUUID, initialPrompt, firstResponse), `NameSessionResponse` (sessionName, sessionUUID).

tasks.title: Define Environment Variable TypeScript Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/environment.d.ts`. Use declaration merging (`declare global { namespace NodeJS { interface ProcessEnv { ... } } }`) to define types for all environment variables specified in `.env.example` (e.g., `OPENAI_API_KEY: string;`).

tasks.title: Define Default Application Constants
tasks.prompt: Create `constants/defaults.ts`. Define and export constants for default values used in the application, such as `DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE = 0.7`, `DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 500`, `INITIAL_SESSION_NAME_PREFIX = 'Session'`.

tasks.title: Define LLM Provider Constants
tasks.prompt: Create `constants/llm-providers.ts`. Define and export constants or an enum for identifying supported LLM providers (e.g., `OPENAI = 'OpenAI'`, `ANTHROPIC = 'Anthropic'`) to ensure consistent usage in configuration and code.

tasks.title: Define Local Storage Key Constants
tasks.prompt: Create `constants/storage-keys.ts`. Define and export a constant for the key used to store the persisted Zustand state in Local Storage, e.g., `export const ZUSTAND_STORAGE_KEY = 'skaldur-storage';`.

tasks.title: Create Improvement Options JSON Config
tasks.prompt: Create `config/improvement-options.json`. Populate it with an initial set of improvement options. Include a `types` array (each object matching `ImprovementType` with `id`, `name`, `icon`, `description`, `systemPrompt`, `template`) and a `styles` array (strings like 'No Style', 'Concise', 'Formal').

tasks.title: Create LLM Options JSON Config
tasks.prompt: Create `config/llm-options.json`. Populate it with initial lists of supported LLMs. Include `interactionLlmOptions` and `destinationLlmOptions` arrays, each containing objects matching `LLMOptionGroup` (provider name and array of models with `id` and `name`).

tasks.title: Implement API Request Validation Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `lib/validation.ts`. Use Zod to define schemas for validating the request bodies of `/api/improve` (`ImprovePromptRequest`) and `/api/name-session` (`NameSessionRequest`). Export these schemas for use in the API route handlers.

tasks.title: Implement Server-Side LLM API Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `lib/llm-utils.server.ts`. Implement async functions to interact with external LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic). Functions should take necessary parameters (prompt, model, settings), securely retrieve API keys from `process.env`, handle API calls using `fetch`, and return responses or throw standardized errors.

tasks.title: Implement API Route: Get Configuration Options
tasks.prompt: Create `app/api/config/improvement-options/route.ts`. Implement the `GET` request handler. Read data from `config/improvement-options.json` and `config/llm-options.json`. Format the response according to `ImprovementOptionsResponse`, excluding backend-only fields from `types`. Return a JSON response.

tasks.title: Implement API Route: Improve Prompt (Structure)
tasks.prompt: Create `app/api/improve/route.ts`. Set up the basic structure for the `POST` handler. Include necessary imports (NextResponse, types, validation schema). Define the async function signature `export async function POST(request: Request)`. Add basic try/catch block.

tasks.title: Implement Improve Prompt: Validation & Context
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/api/improve/route.ts`. Parse the request body. Validate it using the Zod schema from `lib/validation.ts`. Extract `userInput`, `improvementTypeId`, `improvementStyle`, `destinationLLM` context, and `sessionUUID`. Handle validation errors by returning a 400 response.

tasks.title: Implement Improve Prompt: LLM Interaction
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/api/improve/route.ts`. Retrieve the correct `ImprovementType` config based on `improvementTypeId`. Construct the meta-prompt using its `systemPrompt` and `template`, incorporating `userInput`, `improvementStyle`, and `destinationLLM` info. Determine Interaction LLM settings (use defaults or settings associated with session context). Call the appropriate function in `lib/llm-utils.server.ts`. Return `ImprovePromptResponse` on success, handle LLM errors with 500 response.

tasks.title: Implement API Route: Name Session (Structure)
tasks.prompt: Create `app/api/name-session/route.ts`. Set up the basic structure for the `POST` handler, including imports (NextResponse, types, validation schema), the async function signature `export async function POST(request: Request)`, and a basic try/catch block.

tasks.title: Implement Name Session: Validation & LLM Logic
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/api/name-session/route.ts`. Parse and validate the request body (`NameSessionRequest`). Construct a meta-prompt instructing the Interaction LLM to generate a concise session name based on `initialPrompt` and `firstResponse`. Retrieve Interaction LLM context for the session. Call `lib/llm-utils.server.ts`. Return `NameSessionResponse` on success, handle errors.

tasks.title: Create Zustand UI State Slice
tasks.prompt: Create `store/ui-slice.ts`. Define a Zustand slice (`UiState` interface and `createUiSlice` function). Include state for `isSessionSidebarOpen`, `isConfigSidebarOpen`, `currentError` (object or null), and potentially global loading flags. Implement actions like `toggleSessionSidebar`, `toggleConfigSidebar`, `setError`, `clearError`.

tasks.title: Create Zustand Config State Slice
tasks.prompt: Create `store/config-slice.ts`. Define a Zustand slice (`ConfigState` and `createConfigSlice`). Include state for `types`, `styles`, `interactionLlmOptions`, `destinationLlmOptions`, and a loading/error status for the config fetch. Implement an action `setConfigOptions` to update the state.

tasks.title: Create Zustand Session State Slice (Initial)
tasks.prompt: Create `store/session-slice.ts`. Define the slice (`SessionState` and `createSessionSlice`). Include state for `sessions` (map `uuid -> SessionMetadata`), `sessionDetails` (map `uuid -> SessionDetails`), `activeSessionUUID` (string or null). Implement initial actions: `setActiveSessionUUID`, `addSession`, `updateSessionName`, `addMessageToSession`, `setLockedSettings`.

tasks.title: Implement Session Slice Persistence Middleware
tasks.prompt: Modify `store/session-slice.ts`. Import `persist` and `createJSONStorage` from `zustand/middleware`. Wrap the slice creator with `persist`. Configure it to save `sessions`, `sessionDetails`, and `activeSessionUUID` to `localStorage` using the key from `constants/storage-keys.ts`. Define `name` and `storage` options.

tasks.title: Combine Zustand Slices and Export Store
tasks.prompt: Create `store/index.ts`. Import the slice creators (`createUiSlice`, `createConfigSlice`, `createSessionSlice`). Use the Zustand `create` function with the slice pattern (`create((...a) => ({ ...createUiSlice(...a), ... }))`) to combine all slices into a single store. Export the resulting `useStore` hook.

tasks.title: Setup Root Application Layout
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/layout.tsx`. Ensure it defines the root `<html>` and `<body>` tags. Apply global CSS classes (e.g., for background, font). Import and apply custom fonts from `styles/fonts.css` if used. Render the `{children}` prop within the body.

tasks.title: Create Main Application View Layout
tasks.prompt: Create `app/(main)/layout.tsx`. This layout wraps the main application page. Import and render the primary layout components: `SessionSidebar`, `ConfigSidebar`, and the main content area passed via `{children}`. Use CSS (Flexbox/Grid) for the three-column structure.

tasks.title: Create Main Application Page Structure
tasks.prompt: Create `app/(main)/page.tsx`. Mark as a client component (`'use client'`). This component will render the central part of the UI. Include placeholders or import the `HistoryDisplay` and `PromptInputArea` components. Set up basic state or effects for initial data loading.

tasks.title: Define Custom Fonts CSS (Optional)
tasks.prompt: Create `styles/fonts.css` only if using custom web fonts. Define `@font-face` rules for each font weight/style needed. Ensure font files are placed appropriately (e.g., in `public/fonts`) and paths are correct.

tasks.title: Replace Default Favicon
tasks.prompt: Replace the default `app/favicon.ico` file with the custom Skaldur project favicon.

tasks.title: Add Static Icons (Optional)
tasks.prompt: If static icons (beyond Shadcn's Lucide icons) are needed, create the `public/icons/` directory and add the necessary SVG or image files there.

tasks.title: Install Required Shadcn/ui Components
tasks.prompt: Run `npx shadcn-ui@latest add [component]` for each required UI primitive: `button`, `sheet`, `dialog`, `dropdown-menu`, `textarea`, `input`, `select`, `scroll-area`, `separator`, `tooltip`, `label`. This populates the `components/ui` directory.

tasks.title: Implement Session Sidebar Component UI
tasks.prompt: Create `components/layout/SessionSidebar.tsx`. Use Shadcn `Sheet` for the retractable container. Implement the UI: include a header, a '+' button (use Lucide icon), and a list area (placeholder for now). Mark as client component.

tasks.title: Implement Config Sidebar Component UI
tasks.prompt: Create `components/layout/ConfigSidebar.tsx`. Use Shadcn `Sheet`. Implement the UI structure: include sections for Interaction LLM settings, Destination LLM settings, and a placeholder for the 'Fork Session' button. Mark as client component.

tasks.title: Implement App Layout Client Wrapper (Optional)
tasks.prompt: Create `components/layout/AppLayoutClient.tsx` only if client-side state (like sidebar toggles) needs to be managed directly within the main layout structure. Wrap the layout children and manage state here.

tasks.title: Implement Session List Item Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/SessionListItem.tsx`. Implement a component that takes session metadata (name, uuid, potentially timestamp) as props. Display the name. Make it clickable and style it appropriately (e.g., highlight active session).

tasks.title: Implement Chat Message Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/ChatMessage.tsx`. Implement a component taking message data (role: 'user' | 'assistant', content) as props. Render content within a styled bubble, visually differentiating user and assistant messages (e.g., alignment, background color).

tasks.title: Implement History Display Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/HistoryDisplay.tsx`. Use Shadcn `ScrollArea` for vertical scrolling. Fetch and map over the active session's messages array. Render a `ChatMessage` component for each message. Implement auto-scrolling to the bottom on new messages.

tasks.title: Implement LLM Configuration Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/LlmConfiguration.tsx`. Implement a reusable form section using Shadcn `Select` (Provider, Model) and `Input` (Temperature, Max Tokens). Receive available options and current values as props. Handle state changes via `onChange` props. Include labels.

tasks.title: Implement Improvement Selectors Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/ImprovementSelectors.tsx`. Use Shadcn `Select` or `DropdownMenu` for 'Improvement Type' and 'Style'. Populate options based on props (fetched config). Manage selected values locally and notify parent via `onChange` props.

tasks.title: Implement Prompt Input Area Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/PromptInputArea.tsx`. Use Shadcn `Textarea` for multi-line input. Integrate the `ImprovementSelectors` component. Add a Shadcn `Button` for submission. Manage textarea value state. Handle submit event.

tasks.title: Implement Sidebar Toggle Hook
tasks.prompt: Create `hooks/use-sidebar-toggle.ts`. Implement a custom hook that interacts with the `ui-slice` of the Zustand store. Provide functions to open, close, or toggle the session and config sidebars by dispatching actions.

tasks.title: Implement Session Manager Hook
tasks.prompt: Create `hooks/use-session-manager.ts`. Implement a hook providing a high-level API for session management. Use `useStore` internally to interact with `session-slice`. Expose functions like `createNewSession`, `setActiveSession`, `forkActiveSession`, `addMessage`, `updateSessionName`, `setLockedSettings`, `getActiveSessionDetails`.

tasks.title: Implement Local Storage Hook (Optional)
tasks.prompt: Create `hooks/use-local-storage.ts` only if direct, non-Zustand interaction with Local Storage is needed. Implement a generic hook `useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T)` that handles getting, setting, and potentially synchronizing state with Local Storage.

tasks.title: Implement API Client Utility Functions
tasks.prompt: Create `lib/api-client.ts`. Implement async functions for frontend API calls: `fetchImprovementOptions()`, `improvePrompt(payload: ImprovePromptRequest)`, `nameSession(payload: NameSessionRequest)`. Use native `fetch`, set correct headers (Content-Type), handle JSON request/response bodies, use API types, perform basic error handling (check `response.ok`).

tasks.title: Implement Client-Side Session Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `lib/session-utils.ts`. Add any necessary client-side pure functions for working with session data, e.g., function to generate a default session name with timestamp, function to create a new message object, etc.

tasks.title: Integrate State into Session Sidebar
tasks.prompt: Modify `components/layout/SessionSidebar.tsx`. Use `useStore` to select `state.sessions` and `state.activeSessionUUID`. Use `useSessionManager` hook to get `createNewSession` and `setActiveSession` functions. Map over sessions, render `SessionListItem`, handle clicks. Wire '+' button.

tasks.title: Integrate State into Config Sidebar
tasks.prompt: Modify `components/layout/ConfigSidebar.tsx`. Use `useStore` to get active session details (especially `lockedSettings`) and config options (`llmOptions`). Use `useSessionManager` for `forkActiveSession`. Conditionally render `LlmConfiguration` (passing options/handlers) or read-only display. Wire 'Fork' button.

tasks.title: Integrate State into History Display
tasks.prompt: Modify `components/feature/HistoryDisplay.tsx`. Use `useSessionManager` or `useStore` to get the `messages` array for the currently active session. Pass the messages data to the mapping function that renders `ChatMessage` components.

tasks.title: Integrate State into Prompt Input Area
tasks.prompt: Modify `components/feature/PromptInputArea.tsx`. Use `useStore` to get configuration options (`types`, `styles`) for selectors. Use `useSessionManager` to get `addMessage` and `setLockedSettings`. Handle submit: call `improvePrompt` API, on success update store with user/assistant messages, handle locking.

tasks.title: Implement Initial Config Data Fetching
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/(main)/page.tsx` or a client component within the layout. Use `useEffect` hook (run once on mount) to call `fetchImprovementOptions` from `lib/api-client.ts`. On success, dispatch the `setConfigOptions` action from `config-slice` to update the store.

tasks.title: Implement Core Workflow Orchestration
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/(main)/page.tsx`. Ensure child components (`HistoryDisplay`, `PromptInputArea`) receive necessary data derived from the active session state. Manage overall loading states related to session switching or initial loads.

tasks.title: Implement Session Locking Logic
tasks.prompt: Modify `store/session-slice.ts` (and potentially `useSessionManager`). Ensure the action handling the successful response of the *first* prompt improvement correctly updates the `lockedSettings` field within the corresponding `sessionDetails` entry for the active session.

tasks.title: Implement Auto Session Naming Trigger Logic
tasks.prompt: Modify the submit handler in `components/feature/PromptInputArea.tsx` or the logic in `useSessionManager`. After processing a successful response from `/api/improve`, check if it was the first improvement for the session. If so, call `nameSession` from `lib/api-client.ts` and update the session name via store action.

tasks.title: Implement Global Error State Handling
tasks.prompt: Modify error handling within API call functions in `lib/api-client.ts` or in component submit handlers. When a critical API error occurs, extract the error message and dispatch the `setError` action from `ui-slice` to update the global error state.

tasks.title: Implement Global Error Modal Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/ui/ErrorModal.tsx` (or similar name). Use Shadcn `Dialog`. This component should select `currentError` from `ui-slice`. If `currentError` is not null, display the modal with the error message and a button to dispatch `clearError` action.

tasks.title: Configure Vitest Test Runner
tasks.prompt: Create `vitest.config.ts`. Configure Vitest: set `globals: true`, `environment: 'jsdom'`, add `@vitejs/plugin-react`, reference setup file (`setupFiles: ['./tests/setup/vitest.setup.ts']`), configure path aliases to match `tsconfig.json`.

tasks.title: Configure Playwright E2E Runner
tasks.prompt: Create `playwright.config.ts`. Configure Playwright: set `testDir: './tests/e2e'`, define `baseURL` (e.g., 'http://localhost:3000'), configure browsers to test, potentially set up the `webServer` command to start the dev server.

tasks.title: Create Vitest Global Setup File
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/setup/vitest.setup.ts`. Import testing library matchers (`import '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest';`). Import and configure MSW server (`import { server } from './msw-server'; beforeAll(() => server.listen()); afterEach(() => server.resetHandlers()); afterAll(() => server.close());`).

tasks.title: Create MSW Server Setup and Handlers
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/setup/msw-server.ts`. Import `setupServer` from `msw/node` and request handlers (`http`) from `msw`. Define mock handlers for all backend API endpoints (`/api/config/improvement-options`, `/api/improve`, `/api/name-session`) returning mock success/error responses. Export the configured `server`.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests for Session Slice
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/store/session-slice.spec.ts`. Write Vitest unit tests for `session-slice` actions (creating, updating, locking, adding messages, forking). Test initial state and selectors. Mock persistence if needed.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests for Session Manager Hook
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/hooks/useSessionManager.spec.ts`. Use Vitest and RTL's `renderHook`. Test the functions returned by `useSessionManager` (e.g., `createNewSession`, `setActiveSession`). Mock store interactions to verify correct actions are dispatched.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests for Session Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/lib/session-utils.spec.ts`. Write Vitest unit tests for any pure functions defined in `lib/session-utils.ts`, ensuring they produce the expected outputs for various inputs.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests for Session List Item Component
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/components/SessionListItem.spec.tsx`. Use Vitest and RTL. Test that the component renders the correct session name based on props. Simulate click events and verify the correct handler/action is called.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests for Prompt Input Area Component
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/components/PromptInputArea.spec.tsx`. Use Vitest and RTL. Test controlled textarea input. Test rendering of selectors based on props. Simulate submit event and verify API client function (`improvePrompt`) is called with correct arguments. Mock store/hook interactions.

tasks.title: Write Integration Tests for Improve API Route
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/integration/api/improve.integration.spec.ts`. Use Vitest/Supertest or fetch mocking. Send mock POST requests to the running `/api/improve` endpoint (mocking `llm-utils.server.ts`). Verify request validation, context handling, and correct success/error response structures.

tasks.title: Write Integration Tests for Name Session API Route
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/integration/api/name-session.integration.spec.ts`. Use Vitest/Supertest or fetch mocking. Send mock POST requests to `/api/name-session` (mocking `llm-utils.server.ts`). Verify validation and correct success/error response structures.

tasks.title: Write E2E Tests for Session Management Flow
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/e2e/session.spec.ts`. Use Playwright. Write tests covering: clicking '+' to create a session, verifying initial state, switching between sessions, verifying history/state loads correctly, using the 'Fork Session' button, verifying new session is created and unlocked.

tasks.title: Write E2E Tests for Core Improvement Workflow
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/e2e/improvement.spec.ts`. Use Playwright. Write tests covering: selecting LLM settings in a new session, entering a prompt, selecting Type/Style, submitting, verifying history update, verifying config sidebar locks, editing prompt, submitting again, verifying history.

tasks.title: Create Preview Deployment Workflow
tasks.prompt: Create `.github/workflows/deploy-preview.yml`. Configure a GitHub Actions workflow triggered on pushes to feature branches. Include steps for build (`npm run build`) and deployment to a preview environment (e.g., using Vercel CLI `vercel deploy` or GitHub integration).

tasks.title: Create Production Deployment Workflow
tasks.prompt: Create `.github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml`. Configure a GitHub Actions workflow triggered on merge to `main` or tag creation. Include steps for build (`npm run build`), potentially running tests, and deploying to production (e.g., `vercel deploy --prod`). Ensure production secrets are handled securely.

tasks.title: Finalize Project README
tasks.prompt: Update `README.md`. Ensure all sections (Overview, Features, Getting Started, Usage) are accurate and reflect the final application state. Add links to deployment (if applicable) and potentially contribution guidelines.

tasks.title: Finalize Architecture Document
tasks.prompt: Update `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. Fill in details for all sections based on the final implementation. Clarify any design decisions made during development. Ensure consistency with the final codebase structure.

tasks.title: Finalize API Guide Document
tasks.prompt: Update `docs/API_GUIDE.md`. Provide complete documentation for each API endpoint, including final request/response schemas (with examples), potential error codes, and any notes on usage or authentication (even if none currently).
